integer_definition.sampling: center=p+t*(dy,dx); flanks=center +/- distance*(-dx,dy); t=-r..r inclusive, r=(length-1)//2
integer_definition.border: REPLICATE image coordinates; original evaluation FOV unchanged
integer_definition.support: min(sum(left-center), sum(right-center)); int16 exact, no division
integer_definition.persistence_test: none has no count gate; majority needs at least (length+1)//2 individual locations with BOTH left>center AND right>center
integer_definition.combination: OR over the four directions and chosen distances
integer_definition.segmentation: set M0 response to 0 where unsupported, then original segment(response,FOV,28); no post-hoc CPU edit of production mask

diagnostic_regions.full_image: all pixels, includes original FOV-excluded labels
diagnostic_regions.bright_band: 15x15 square dilation(bright_core) minus bright_core, inside original FOV; all image locations, not a selected crop
diagnostic_regions.thin_label_proxy: AH AND 5x5 AH sum<=10 AND 3x3 AH sum<=6 AND FOV; diagnostic only, not a clinical vessel-width label
diagnostic_regions.fov_edge: FOV minus constant-zero 15x15 erosion(FOV); evaluation only

selection_gates.empty_region_policy: report null recall if no GT positives; no claim of protection from an empty set
selection_gates.ranking_after_all_gates: descending 512 AH macro Dice, then fewer distance filters, shorter length, lower margin, none before majority, candidate ID
selection_gates.no_eligible_candidate: REJECT_FAMILY_FOR_PL; preserve all runs; preregister next revision; do not relax gates after results or inspect heldout/VK to tune

adoption_rule: Training gate is necessary, not sufficient. Q2 needs independent fixed-point/actual RTL and timing/resource evidence; Q3 needs real PL output and original full quality/performance experiments.
